openrussian.name: OpenRussian dictionary data
openrussian.changes: Converted into form tables, filtered, levelled by frequency, corrected by hand (tools/overrides.json) and checked against pymorphy3.

frequency.name: FrequencyWords (OpenSubtitles 2018, Russian)
frequency.changes: Used to rank the words and set their levels; the list itself isn't shipped.

pymorphy3.name: pymorphy3 + OpenCorpora dictionaries (build-time verification only)
pymorphy3.changes: Used at build time to check forms and grammatical tags.

tatoeba.name: Tatoeba sentences (Russian + English translations)
tatoeba.changes: Sentences selected by level; stress marks added to the Russian and ё restored. Translations unchanged.
tatoeba.snapshot: rus-eng.zip (536,124 Russian–English pairs), committed to tools/raw/tatoeba/
